description: Java class implementing an OnDragListener for ImageViews, handling drag events to change background colors and set images based on drag-and-drop actions.

classes.name: ImageDragListener
classes.description: Implements drag-and-drop behavior for ImageViews, changing colors and updating images upon drop.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Handles drag events, updates view color, and processes drop actions.

methods.name: setTargetColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the view.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Processes the drop event, retrieves the Uri from ClipData, and sets the image.

methods.name: processLocation
methods.description: Placeholder for processing drag location; currently empty.

methods.name: setImageUri
methods.description: Sets the image URI on an ImageView if the view is an instance of ImageView.
